d: Long, flowing coral-pink hair with thick bangs and two long side-locks is styled with a small gold crescent moon clip on the right side. The eyes are a matching coral-pink with a wide, innocent expression, set on a youthful, childlike face. The build is petite and slender, dressed in a navy blue sailor-style top with a red ribbon at the chest and a short, pleated black skirt with a pink underskirt. A small pink rabbit plush is attached to the lower back, and the character is equipped with a dark grey naval gun and ammunition belt.
